reel.scriptStatus: PROPOSAL — 87 words / 39.48s at Helio speed 85 (132.2 wpm, test render). Figs 5 + 4 PENDING from Vishnu. Awaiting Gate 1.

beats.name: Hook — the fix
beats.voiceover: So what's the fix? Don't pick one effort level. Start low.

beats.name: Climb only on failure
beats.voiceover: If the answer fails a check, climb to max — and only then. The paper calls it naïve laddering.
beats.overlay: Naïve laddering · climb only on failure

startFrame.desc: Fig 5's laddering line at the low end; a 'failed check' marker is dim.

endFrame.desc: The green line has stepped up only at the failure marker; the 'naïve laddering' label has appeared; Kit points at the step.

camera.from: Low end of Fig 5's laddering line

character.points: at the step-up point on the line

beats.treatment: Paper figure (Fig 5) animated in Remotion — line steps up at the failure marker
beats.source: Paper figure supplied by Vishnu (PENDING) + Remotion
assets: Fig 5 — PENDING — figure not yet received from Vishnu
beats.notes: The step happens ONLY at the failure marker — that is the whole idea. If the line climbs early, the beat is wrong.

beats.name: Matches or beats max, costs less
beats.voiceover: It matches or beats fixed max effort on every model and benchmark tested — and it costs less.
beats.overlay: Matches or beats max · costs less

endFrame.desc: The laddering line has finished ahead of the fixed-max line (higher success, lower cost); Kit has slid with it, excited.
